name: Seedance 2.5
description: Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, multimodal omni-reference generation, video edit, and video extension

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Generation mode: 't2v' for prompt-only generation, 'omni_reference' for image, video, or audio references, 'video_edit' to edit one reference video (billed by that video's duration; 'duration' and 'aspect_ratio' are ignored), or 'video_extension' to extend a reference video ('aspect_ratio' follows the extended video).

parameters.name: generate_audio
parameters.description: Generate audio for the output video.

parameters.name: bitrate_mode
parameters.description: 'standard' = normal output bitrate; 'high' = higher bitrate output.

parameters.name: extension_mode
parameters.description: Extension direction; required for mode 'video_extension' and not allowed otherwise.
